name: Avoid rivaroxaban with St. John's wort
actions: Avoid concomitant rivaroxaban and St. John's wort as directed in the rivaroxaban label.

rationale: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and P-gp and can reduce rivaroxaban exposure.

explanation_template: St. John's wort can lower rivaroxaban exposure through combined CYP3A4 and P-gp induction. The rivaroxaban label says to avoid this combination.

references.citation: Avoid rivaroxaban with combined P-gp and strong CYP3A4 inducers, including St. John's wort.
